title: Sparkly rubber duck
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff7c2'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffd23f'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#fff6a8'>
    <path d='M14 20 l2 5 l5 2 l-5 2 l-2 5 l-2 -5 l-5 -2 l5 -2z'/>
    <path d='M84 16 l1.6 4 l4 1.6 l-4 1.6 l-1.6 4 l-1.6 -4 l-4 -1.6 l4 -1.6z'/>
    <path d='M88 56 l1.8 4.5 l4.5 1.8 l-4.5 1.8 l-1.8 4.5 l-1.8 -4.5 l-4.5 -1.8 l4.5 -1.8z'/>
    <path d='M10 66 l1.4 3.5 l3.5 1.4 l-3.5 1.4 l-1.4 3.5 l-1.4 -3.5 l-3.5 -1.4 l3.5 -1.4z'/>
    <path d='M72 8 l1.2 3 l3 1.2 l-3 1.2 l-1.2 3 l-1.2 -3 l-3 -1.2 l3 -1.2z'/>
  </g>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='30' ry='22' fill='#ffe14d'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='30' ry='22' fill='none' stroke='#fff29b' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- wing -->
  <path d='M62 62 q14 4 10 14 q-6 8 -14 2 q6 -8 4 -16z' fill='#f4c22a'/>
  <path d='M63 63 q12 4 9 12' fill='none' stroke='#ffe98f' stroke-width='1.6'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M22 64 q-10 -6 -14 -2 q6 6 12 8z' fill='#f4c22a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='36' r='17' fill='#ffe14d'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='36' r='17' fill='none' stroke='#fff29b' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M58 34 q12 1 11 7 q-3 5 -11 4z' fill='#ff8a1e'/>
  <path d='M58 40 q9 1 10 2' fill='none' stroke='#ffc170' stroke-width='1.4'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='31' r='3' fill='#2b2b6b'/>
  <circle cx='51.2' cy='30' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- body shine -->
  <path d='M32 58 q6 -6 14 -6' fill='none' stroke='#fff6b0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
